title: Classical Machine Learning (complete university syllabus)
tagline: Python, data preprocessing, every regression/classification/clustering/dimensionality-reduction/association algorithm, ensembles, learning theory, hyper-parameter optimisation and all evaluation metrics.

topics.title: Python programming and the ML library stack
topics.summary: The programming foundation and the libraries every experiment uses.
items: Python fundamentals: variables, data types, conditionals, loops, functions
Lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets; comprehensions and generators
Object-oriented programming: classes, objects, inheritance, dunder methods
File handling, exception handling, modules and packages
Virtual environments (venv/conda/uv), pinned dependencies, Git
Debugging (traceback, pdb), unit tests, profiling
Algorithms and data structures: Big-O, hashing, heaps, sorting
NumPy: arrays, broadcasting, vectorisation, linear algebra
Pandas: DataFrame, groupby, merge, datetime, missing values
Matplotlib and Seaborn: publication-quality plots
SciPy and Statsmodels: distributions, tests, OLS tables, ARIMA
Scikit-learn: estimator API, pipelines, ColumnTransformer, model_selection
XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, SHAP, PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras overview
questions: Why put preprocessing inside a Pipeline?
What is the difference between a list and a NumPy array for numerical work?
How do you make an experiment reproducible in Python?

topics.title: Data science and data preprocessing
topics.summary: EDA, cleaning, missing values, outliers, scaling, encoding, imbalance, selection, augmentation and leakage.
items: Data collection and integration (joins, deduplication)
Exploratory data analysis (distributions, correlations, missingness maps)
Data cleaning and noise removal
Missing-value treatment: MCAR/MAR/MNAR, mean/median, KNN, iterative imputation
Outlier detection: z-score, IQR, Mahalanobis, Isolation Forest, LOF
Normalisation and standardisation: z-score, min-max, robust, power transforms
Categorical encoding: one-hot, ordinal, target, frequency, hashing, embeddings
Feature extraction and feature engineering (lags, ratios, interactions, cyclical)
Feature selection: filter, wrapper (RFE), embedded (lasso, trees)
Imbalanced datasets: class weights, threshold moving, SMOTE, undersampling
Data augmentation (images, text, audio, time series, tabular)
Train/validation/test splits: stratified, group, time-series, nested CV
Data leakage: target, train-test, temporal and group leakage audits
Data visualisation for papers
questions: Name five forms of data leakage and how to prevent each.
Why is SMOTE applied only inside training folds?
MCAR vs MAR vs MNAR: how does each change imputation?

topics.title: Introduction to machine learning
topics.summary: The map of learning paradigms and the workflow and concepts shared by every model.
items: Supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, self-supervised, reinforcement learning
Regression vs classification vs clustering vs dimensionality reduction
Parametric vs non-parametric, generative vs discriminative models
Loss functions and empirical risk
Overfitting, underfitting, bias-variance trade-off
Regularisation, validation, the full ML workflow
No free lunch and inductive bias
questions: Why can training error be a poor estimate of generalisation?
Generative vs discriminative: when does each win?

topics.title: Regression algorithms
topics.summary: From OLS to Gaussian processes and gradient-boosted regressors.
items: Linear regression: normal equations, assumptions, diagnostics, R-squared
Polynomial regression and the degree/bias-variance dial
Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net: geometry, closed form, coordinate descent
Bayesian linear regression: posterior and predictive distribution
Support Vector Regression and the epsilon-insensitive loss
Gaussian Process regression: kernels, marginal likelihood
KNN regression, decision-tree regression
Random Forest regression, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost regression
Multicollinearity (VIF), heteroscedasticity, robust and quantile regression
questions: Why does lasso give sparse solutions?
Derive the OLS estimator.
Why can't trees extrapolate?
resources: Rasmussen & Williams: Gaussian Processes for ML

topics.title: Classification algorithms
topics.summary: Linear, probabilistic, margin-based and tree-based classifiers.
items: Logistic regression: sigmoid, cross-entropy, regularisation, odds ratios
K-Nearest Neighbours: distance metrics, curse of dimensionality
Support Vector Machines: margin, soft margin, dual, kernels
Naive Bayes: Gaussian, Multinomial, Bernoulli, smoothing
LDA and QDA
Decision trees: ID3, C4.5, CART, pruning
Random Forest, Extra Trees, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost
Perceptron and MLP basics, Gaussian-process classification
Multi-class (OvR, OvO, softmax) and multi-label strategies
questions: LDA vs logistic regression?
Why does the SVM dual depend only on inner products?
Entropy vs Gini impurity?
resources: CS229 notes on SVMs and generative learning

topics.title: Clustering
topics.summary: Partitioning, density, hierarchical, model-based, spectral and neural clustering.
items: K-Means and k-means++, K-Medoids
Hierarchical clustering: linkages, dendrograms, cophenetic correlation
DBSCAN, HDBSCAN, OPTICS
Mean Shift, Spectral clustering
Gaussian Mixture Models and EM
Fuzzy C-Means, Self-Organising Maps
Choosing k: elbow, silhouette, gap, BIC
Cluster stability and validation
questions: K-Means vs GMM?
How does DBSCAN define noise and what are its failure cases?

topics.title: Dimensionality reduction and association rules
topics.summary: Compress, visualise and mine co-occurrence patterns.
items: PCA (eigendecomposition and SVD views), explained variance
SVD / truncated SVD (LSA), NMF
LDA (Fisher), ICA, Factor Analysis
Kernel PCA
MDS, Isomap, LLE
t-SNE and UMAP: how to read them, pitfalls
Autoencoders for dimension reduction
Association rules: support, confidence, lift, conviction
Apriori, FP-Growth, Eclat
Anomaly detection: Isolation Forest, LOF, One-Class SVM
questions: Why must PCA data be centred and (usually) standardised?
What does t-SNE preserve and what does it distort?
Why is confidence alone misleading for association rules?

topics.title: Ensembles, learning theory and hyper-parameter optimisation
topics.summary: Combine models, understand generalisation, and tune systematically.
items: Bagging, Random Forest, boosting, voting, stacking, blending
Gradient boosting math; XGBoost vs LightGBM vs CatBoost
ERM and SRM; approximation vs estimation error
VC dimension, PAC learning, Rademacher complexity
Bias-variance decomposition; learning and validation curves
Cross-validation variants: K-fold, stratified, LOO, repeated, group, time-series, nested
Grid search, random search, Bayesian optimisation (TPE, GP), Hyperband, evolutionary search
Optuna workflow, early stopping and pruning
questions: Why does bagging reduce variance but boosting reduce bias?
State the VC bound and its implication.
Why does random search beat grid search?

topics.title: Evaluation metrics
topics.summary: Classification, regression and clustering metrics, with the right choice and reporting.
items: Confusion matrix, accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, F1, F-beta
ROC curve, AUC, precision-recall curve, average precision
MCC, Cohen's kappa, balanced accuracy, G-mean, log loss, Brier score
Macro, micro and weighted averaging; multi-label metrics
Calibration: reliability diagram, ECE, Platt, isotonic
MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, sMAPE, MASE, R-squared, adjusted R-squared
Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz, ARI, NMI
Choosing a metric by cost; threshold selection on validation data
questions: When is PR-AUC more informative than ROC-AUC?
Why is MAPE problematic?
What is the Adjusted Rand Index correcting for?
resources: The Precision-Recall Plot Is More Informative than the ROC Plot (Saito & Rehmsmeier)
